text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading overseas soon! For my last 
race at home, I can't afford a 
half-hearted run!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today's rival is Biko Pegasus, who aspires 
to be a hero. As for me, I'm "Not Hero." 
I'll show everyone who I really am in the 
race!
